changes.to: Maker page and its specification sheet (a Nova reference configuration): 5 ft (about 152 cm), 70 lb (31.8 kg), wheeled differential drive with zero-radius turning, 0.8-1.2 m/s (1.2 m/s entered as the upper bound), 2-3 kg arm payload (3 kg entered), depth cameras plus RGB camera and IMU, on-device LLM with cloud fallback, voice interaction in English/Spanish/Italian, interactive touchscreen, target runtime up to 10-12 h configuration-dependent (11 h entered as the midpoint), 3 h charge, indoor commercial spaces, Wi-Fi with OTA updates and a monitoring dashboard. Launched December 2025 when the company moved from bipedal testing to a wheeled base with two 7-DOF arms. DOF total, battery capacity and price are not stated.
Nova is StarBot's first-generation wheeled service humanoid — a 5 ft, differential-drive platform with two arms, on-device LLM conversation and a touchscreen, used for hospitality and retail pilots.
